015dde08734f89dc4a191270d3e8f74ae9bde223.text: UnitedHealthcare Medicare Advantage denied coverage for [NAME_1] [NAME_2]'s CPAP device, stating: "The apnea-hypopnea index of 9 is below 15 events per hour, the threshold for coverage of a CPAP device." The cited coverage policy, [RECORD_NUMBER_1], states: "The apnea-hypopnea index is 15 or more, or it is between 5 and 14 with documented excessive daytime sleepiness, hypertension, ischemic heart disease, or a history of stroke." The documented facts satisfy this policy. [NAME_1] [NAME_2]'s apnea-hypopnea index was 9 on [DATE_1], which falls between 5 and 14. Essential hypertension is on the record. Ischemic heart disease is on the record. These comorbidities satisfy the alternative pathway for coverage when the index is between 5 and 14. The denial incorrectly applied only the 15-or-more threshold while overlooking the documented qualifying conditions that meet the policy's explicit exception.
